rudraksha.h: How we source original Nepali Rudraksha
rudraksha.p1: Every bead in this collection comes from Nepal, where Rudraksha trees grow at the altitude that gives beads dense wood and deep, naturally formed mukhi lines. We reject beads with filled cracks, carved lines or joined halves, the three most common signs of a fake.
rudraksha.p2: Each bead is X-ray tested so the internal seed chambers can be matched to the visible mukhi count, then energized with a sankalp during Mahapuja. Your packet carries the lab certificate number and the date of energization.

bracelets.p1: Pick one intention rather than several. A stone chosen for a single purpose, worn daily and cleansed weekly, is easier to live with than a stack of bracelets. If you know your rashi, our team can match the stone to its ruling planet.
bracelets.p2: All beads are 8 mm natural stone on durable stretch cord. Sizes run S (14–15 cm), M (15.5–16.5 cm) and L (17–18 cm); add 1 cm to your wrist measurement for a comfortable fit.

all.p1: Every order is included in the sankalp of the next Mahapuja performed by Sadhak Pawan Pandey on an auspicious muhurat. Products are purified with Ganga jal, placed before the yantra during mantra japa and havan, then sealed and dispatched.
all.p2: This is why orders ship two to four days after energization rather than the same day. You can add personal energization with your name and gotra on any product page.

detail.samplesNote: Names and birth details changed. Every report is written for one seeker and delivered as a PDF on WhatsApp and email.
detail.tiersIntro: Every package includes Sadhak Ji’s preparation before the session and remedies you can follow at home. Prices include taxes.

kundali.title: Kundali Reading
kundali.long: A deep reading of your birth chart covering career, marriage, finance, health and hidden obstacles, with guidance that continues until your doubts are resolved.
kundali.covNote: A chart is read as a whole. Sadhak Ji looks at how the areas affect each other before answering the question you came with.

palm.title: Palmistry, Hastrekha
palm.long: Share clear photographs of both palms. Sadhak Ji reads the life, head, heart and fate lines, the mounts and the turning points, using authentic Hastrekha principles.
palm.covNote: Suits seekers without birth details. The left hand shows what you were born with; the right shows what you are making of it.

tarot.title: Tarot card reading
tarot.long: An intuitive spread for one clear question, especially relationship dilemmas and career crossroads, explained card by card with practical next steps.
tarot.covNote: Tarot is used here as a tool for clarity on present situations, not for long-range prediction.

numerology.title: Numerology, Ank Jyotish
numerology.long: Align your name, mobile number and business name with favourable vibrations, using the science of numbers and your date of birth.
numerology.covNote: Corrections are small and practical: a spelling, a signature, a number pattern, a date.
